in_marathi.name: Bhanavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhanavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhanu means 'sun' and vi means 'knowledge'. This name signifies the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Bhanu-vi. In Hindu mythology, Bhanu is one of the twenty-seven stars (Nakshatras) and is associated with the sun.
